stacking.note: No hardware stacking. Cloud-managed individually via the Meter dashboard / Meter Network Operating System

routing.summary: Layer 2 access with VLANs (up to 4096). Inter-VLAN routing and firewall policy live on Meter gateways/firewalls, not on these switches

redundancy.detail: Fixed internal PSU; no redundant option listed

licensing: Included with Meter Network as a Service. Hardware is provisioned and managed as part of the Meter subscription rather than sold as standalone switches with a separate license SKU
verifyNote: S1 lists packet buffer as 3 MB; S2 lists 3M bits on the same generation sheet (treated as 3 MB). Confirm against a formal Meter datasheet if one is published

models.note: 24x 10/100/1000/2500BASE-T with IEEE 802.3bt Type 3 Class 6 (60W) PoE++. 6x 1/10/25G SFP28. 1x 1G RJ-45 OOB. ~18 dBA normal operation. MTBF 305k hours
48x 10/100/1000/2500BASE-T (non-PoE). 6x 1/10/25G SFP28. 1x console + 1x 1G RJ-45 OOB. ~18 dBA normal operation. MTBF 688k hours
